name: Demoblaze User Access
description:
In order to buy products in the store
  As a new customer
  I want to register my account and log in to the platform

steps.name: I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User can sign up and log in successfully

steps.name: I register successfully and log in with new valid credentials
the welcome message for the generated user should be displayed in the navbar
I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User cannot log in with an invalid password

steps.name: I have a newly registered user account
I log in with the generated username and password "WrongPass123"
an alert message saying "Wrong password." is displayed
I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User cannot log in with a non-existing user

name: Demoblaze Store App
description:
In order to buy products in the store
  As a customer
  I want to browse products and manage my cart

steps.name: I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User can browse laptops and open a product detail

steps.name: I filter products by category "Laptops"
I open the product detail for "Sony vaio i5"
the product detail title should be "Sony vaio i5"
the "Add to cart" action should be visible
I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User can add a product to cart from product detail

steps.name: I open the product detail for "Samsung galaxy s6"
I add the current product to the cart successfully
I go to the cart page
the cart should contain the product "Samsung galaxy s6"
I am on the Demoblaze homepage

elements.name: User can remove a product from cart

steps.name: I open the product detail for "Nokia lumia 1520"
I add the current product to the cart successfully
I go to the cart page
I remove the product "Nokia lumia 1520" from the cart
the cart should not contain the product "Nokia lumia 1520"

name: Categories Filter Navigation
description:
As a customer
  I want to be able to navigate through the different categories of products
  So that I can easily find the products I am interested in

steps.name: I am on the Demoblaze homepage
I click the "Phones" category link in the sidebar
I should see a list of products related to the "Phones" category at the top
I am on the Demoblaze homepage
I click the "Laptops" category link in the sidebar
I should see a list of products related to the "Laptops" category at the top
I am on the Demoblaze homepage
I click the "Monitors" category link in the sidebar
I should see a list of products related to the "Monitors" category at the top
